publicationPolicy.note: Recovered Genetics/MOPS visuals, DRAFT G×E artwork, recovered sex-expression artwork, and THC-ENC-004 reference-only panels are intentionally excluded.

population-structure-lineage-identity.title: Domestication, Dispersal & Selection
population-structure-lineage-identity.alt: Finished educational infographic connecting cannabis domestication, dispersal and human selection with population history and genetic diversity.

gaps.title: Genotype → Environment → Phenotype
gaps.neededVisual: A purpose-built model showing inherited genotype, environment, developmental history and genotype-by-environment interaction converging on measured phenotype.

gaps.title: Genes, Regulation & Gene Expression
gaps.neededVisual: A reviewed genetics diagram distinguishing possession of a gene or allele from when, where and how strongly it is expressed, without implying that expression equals a fixed visible trait.

gaps.title: Simple vs Quantitative Traits
gaps.neededVisual: A comparison of relatively simple inheritance with polygenic quantitative traits, continuous distributions, environment effects and measurement requirements.

gaps.title: Cannabis Population Structure & Admixture
gaps.neededVisual: A genetics diagram showing broad cannabis population structure, admixture and ancestry uncertainty while explaining why commercial sativa/indica labels are not equivalent to genome-wide identity.

gaps.title: Pedigree, Lineage & Genetic Identity
gaps.neededVisual: A diagram separating a recorded pedigree from independently verified genetic identity, including parent IDs, source records, possible stray pollen or mix-ups and uncertainty notation.

gaps.title: Mendelian Inheritance & Punnett-Square Interpretation
gaps.neededVisual: A carefully bounded Punnett-square lesson explaining alleles, genotype ratios, phenotype assumptions and why simple ratios apply only when the biological assumptions are satisfied.

gaps.title: F1, F2 & Segregation
gaps.neededVisual: A multigeneration diagram showing parent structure, F1 heterozygosity, F2 segregation and recombination while explaining why generation labels alone do not guarantee uniformity.

gaps.title: Backcrossing & Recurrent-Parent Recovery
gaps.neededVisual: A multigeneration backcross diagram showing recurrent parent, donor trait, recombination and why expected genomic contribution does not guarantee whole-plant identity or trait fixation.

gaps.title: THCAS/CBDAS Chemotype Inheritance
gaps.neededVisual: A modern evidence-aware genetics diagram connecting Type I/II/III chemotype segregation with THCAS/CBDAS loci, structural complexity, marker limits and measured cannabinoid phenotype.

gaps.title: Sex Determination vs Sex Expression
gaps.neededVisual: A reviewed XX/XY and floral-expression diagram separating chromosomal sex from observed male, female or intersex floral expression and showing genotype, hormone and environment context.

gaps.title: Regular, Feminized & Autoflower Genetics
gaps.neededVisual: A genetics comparison separating regular seed sex outcomes, feminized-seed production context and autoflowering inheritance without presenting any category as inherently superior.

gaps.title: Selection Funnel & Progeny Testing
gaps.neededVisual: A breeding workflow moving from written objectives to phenotype measurement, culling, parent choice, offspring testing and evidence-based retention across generations.

gaps.title: Quantitative Phenotyping & Trait Measurement
gaps.neededVisual: A measurement-focused diagram showing trait definition, units, timing, replication, environmental context and raw-value retention before subjective scoring.

gaps.title: Family Pedigree & Stable-ID Example
gaps.neededVisual: A breeding pedigree showing stable plant IDs, parent IDs, cross IDs, generation, family and seed-lot traceability even when commercial line names change.

gaps.title: Uniformity Is Trait-Specific
gaps.neededVisual: A matrix comparing one breeding line across sex, chemotype, flowering time, architecture, aroma and yield to show that a line can be uniform for one trait while variable for another.

gaps.title: Line Development & Release Gates
gaps.neededVisual: A generational breeding diagram showing population size, family selection, negative-trait tracking, retesting and explicit release criteria rather than using F-number alone as a quality claim.

gaps.title: Pollination → Fertilization → Seed Development
gaps.neededVisual: A reproductive sequence showing pollen capture, pollen-tube growth, fertilization, embryo development and mature seed formation linked to controlled-parentage records.

gaps.title: Polyploidy in Cannabis Breeding
gaps.neededVisual: A neutral overview of diploid versus polyploid chromosome sets, induction versus natural occurrence, confirmation methods and trait claims that require direct measurement.

gaps.title: Marker-Assisted vs Genomic Selection
gaps.neededVisual: A modern breeding diagram comparing single/few-marker decisions with genome-wide prediction, training populations, phenotype requirements, validation and discordant-case review.

gaps.title: Pangenomes & Structural Variation
gaps.neededVisual: A genomic diagram showing why a single reference genome can miss presence/absence and structural variation captured across a cannabis pangenome.

gaps.title: Breeding Records & Evidence Chain
gaps.neededVisual: A traceability diagram connecting stable IDs, parents, pollination event, family, seed lot, generation, phenotype records, marker data and release evidence into one auditable breeding record.
